name: Walpole Island
location: At the head of Lake St. Clair.
tribe_band: Chippewas and Pottawattamies of Walpole island.
remarks: The Chippewas settled on the island in 1831 by order of the Government. The island appears to have been then set apart by the Government as a Crown reserve to be used for the purpose of settling Indians thereon. The Pottawattamies came from the United States in 1841, and, on petition, were permitted by the Government to settle on the island.
